name: CheckBatchTableAccessPermission

parameters.help_en:
The database ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html operation to query the ID of a physical database and the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html operation to query the ID of a logical database.

>  The value of DatabaseId is that of DbId
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html获取物理库ID的值，调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html获取逻辑库ID的值。
>DatabaseId的值即为DbId的值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

*   true: Logical database.
*   false: Physical database
parameters.help_zh:
是否逻辑库，取值：
- true：逻辑库
- false：物理库
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en:
The type of the permission to be verified.

Valid values:

*   QUERY
*   EXPORT
*   CORRECT
*   LOGIN
*   PERF
parameters.name: permission_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

>  View Tenant ID by hovering over your profile icon in the DMS console. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
> 取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid
